selection_rule: include every replay pair for which both arms are valid and both are incorrect; preserve all such pairs without further filtering
review_unit: one goal and the same eight action descriptions per pair; choice letters are independently shuffled and mapped only in the hidden key
blinding: the reviewer packet omits task ids, authors, historical labels, named/opaque model choices, raw model responses, pair indices, and action identifiers; action identifiers, task ids, and round ids quoted inside goals are redacted, and only the hidden key can decode choices
reviewer_task: select exactly one of eight unnamed action descriptions and rate confidence without consulting the replay artifact, key, notes, or another model

primary_comparison.informative_case: reviewer choice decodes to exactly one of the two candidates
primary_comparison.test: two-sided exact binomial test on current-vs-historical discordant choices at probability 0.5

primary_outcomes.historical_label_noise_supported: current candidate wins more informative cases and the two-sided exact binomial p is below alpha
primary_outcomes.historical_label_noise_not_supported: historical candidate wins more informative cases and the two-sided exact binomial p is below alpha

secondary_outcomes: reviewer match rate for historical label, opaque choice, named choice, and either current choice
confidence-stratified counts without changing the primary outcome
power_note: at most 22 items are reviewed, and non-informative reviewer choices further reduce discordant pairs; an inconclusive result does not mean the two candidates are equivalent
claim_boundary: this adjudicates only the 22 both-wrong replay pairs; even a clear result cannot validate the replay overall, establish semantic understanding, or prove collective intelligence
